sage.name: Sage & Cream
sage.description: Herb green on warm cream, terracotta highlights

paprika.name: Paprika & Linen
paprika.description: Burnt orange on linen, olive highlights

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: There's nothing here. The link may be old or mistyped.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.

comingSoon.title: Coming soon
comingSoon.today: What's cooking today, and what needs using up.
comingSoon.list: The shopping list, made from the plan.
comingSoon.pantry: What's in the cupboards, and what's running low.

fields.name: Name
fields.usernameHint: 3 to 30 letters, numbers, dots or underscores.

login.title: Sign in
login.wrong: That username or password isn't right.
login.tooMany: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.

setup.title: Set up Merran
setup.description: Make the first account. It runs this server and starts your household.
setup.codeHint: It's in the server's log, printed when Merran started.
setup.householdHint: Like “The Carters”. You can change it later.

join.title: Join {{household}}
join.signedIn: You can switch between your households from the account menu.
join.haveAccount: Already have an account? <link>Sign in</link> first.
join.used: It's been used already. Ask for a new link.
join.expired: It has expired. Ask for a new link.
join.notFound: The link isn't right, or the invite was cancelled. Ask for a new link.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: How you appear to your household.
profile.emailFixed: Your email can't be changed yet.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: For connecting other apps, like Home Assistant. A key acts as you in one household, with only the access you give it.
apiKeys.noneHint: Make one to connect another app.
apiKeys.makeDescription: For {{household}}. It stops working if you leave the household.
apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.permissionsHint: Give only what the app needs. Managing the household always needs a sign-in.
apiKeys.madeDescription: Copy it now and keep it somewhere safe. It won't be shown again.
apiKeys.revokeDescription: It stops working straight away. Anything using it will need a new key.

myData.title: Your data
myData.description: Your account, the households you're in, the cooking notes you wrote and your API keys' names and permissions (never the keys), as a file to keep. A household's recipes are in its export.

share.title: Share to Merran
share.description: Add a recipe from any app on your phone: share its web page, or a link to it, to Merran.
share.androidSteps: In Chrome, open the menu (⋮) and tap Install app or Add to home screen. Then, in any app, tap Share and pick Merran.
share.needsHttps: This needs Merran opened at its https address, not a local one like this.
share.iphoneIntro: Apple only lets App Store apps into the share sheet, but a Shortcut can be there instead. It takes a few minutes to set up, once.
share.makeKey: Make a key for the Shortcut

steps.create: Open Shortcuts, tap +, and name it Send to Merran.
steps.shareSheet: Tap ⓘ and turn on Show in Share Sheet.
steps.fetch: Add the action Get Contents of URL, with this address:
steps.method: Tap the arrow beside it, and set Method to POST. Under Headers, add Authorization, with this:
steps.body: Under Request Body, pick Form, add a File field named file, and set it to Shortcut Input.
steps.message: Add Get Dictionary Value, for the key message.

share.after: Now, in Safari or any app, tap Share, then Send to Merran. A notification says what was added.
share.keyNote: The key can only add recipes, to {{household}}, and it's yours: someone else needs their own. It's in your API keys, where it can be removed.

planning.title: Planning
planning.description: The meals your household plans: all of them, unless you turn some off. A meal you turn off keeps anything already planned in it.

household.noneHint: Ask someone in a household for an invite link.

details.title: Household
details.description: Its name, and how days and weeks work in the plan.
details.adminsOnly: Only the household's admins can change these.
details.name: Name
details.weekStartsOnHint: The first day of the plan's week.

members.title: Members
members.removeDescription: They lose access to this household straight away. They can come back with a new invite link.
members.leaveDescription: You lose access to it straight away. To come back, you'll need a new invite link.

invites.title: Invite links
invites.description: Each link works once, for 7 days.
invites.noneHint: Make a link to invite someone.
invites.makeDescription: Anyone with the link can join, so send it only to the person you're inviting.
invites.roleHint: Admins can change the household's settings and invite people.
invites.madeDescription: Copy it now and send it. It won't be shown again.

new.title: Start another household
new.description: As a server admin, you can start more households. You'll own it and switch to it.

tastes.title: Tastes
tastes.description: What your household eats and doesn't. Fill the week keeps to it. Anyone in the household can change it.
tastes.avoidHint: Nuts, dairy, gluten, eggs and meat get the same careful check as the diet labels: pesto has nuts, butter is dairy. An allergy is never suggested.

themes.title: Theme nights
themes.description: A theme for each night's dinner, like taco night or fish on Friday. Fill the week suggests dinners that fit: tagged or named for it, vegetarian for meatless, never made for something new. Leftovers and eat-out nights stay empty.
themes.tagPlaceholder: A tag, like curry or burgers

about.title: This server
about.noAddress: Not set, so links use the address in the browser

errorTracking.title: Error tracking
errorTracking.description: Send errors from the server and from browsers to your own Sentry, GlitchTip or Bugsink. Reports leave out cookies, keys and who was signed in.
errorTracking.dsnHint: From your error tracker's project settings. Leave it empty to keep errors in the server's log only.
errorTracking.environmentHint: To tell this server's errors apart from others'.
errorTracking.saved: Saved. Browsers pick it up when they next open Merran.

telemetry.title: Telemetry
telemetry.description: An anonymous summary once a day helps the Merran project see how many servers run it, on which versions, and which parts get used.
telemetry.send: Send an anonymous summary once a day
telemetry.never: Never names, recipes, keys, or anything anyone typed.
telemetry.installIdHint: The install id is random. A new one means later summaries can't be linked to earlier ones.

jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.description: Work Merran does in the background: imports, emptying Recently deleted, the daily summary. Finished jobs stay here for 30 days.

kinds.purgeDeleted: Emptying old recipes from Recently deleted

export.title: Export this household
export.description: A zip of its recipes, with their photos, versions, cooking notes and pairings, to keep or to move to another Merran. Recipes in Recently deleted, AI keys and other secrets stay behind.

import.title: Import a Merran export
import.description: Recipes from a Merran export, with their photos, versions, cooking notes and pairings. Recipes already here are skipped, so importing the same export twice is safe.
import.newHint: Named and set up as in the export, with you as its owner. You'll switch to it.

progress.stopped: Stopped. The recipes it brought in stay.

apps.title: From another app
apps.description: Recipes from Mealie or Paprika, with their photos, ratings and notes. Recipes an earlier import brought in are skipped, so importing again brings in only what's new.
apps.fileHint: A Mealie backup (in Mealie's Admin → Backups), recipes exported from Mealie, or a Paprika export (.paprikarecipes).
apps.alreadyHere_one: {{count}} is here already, so it's skipped.
apps.alreadyHere_other: {{count}} are here already, so they're skipped.
apps.allHere: Every recipe in it is here already.
apps.groupHint: This backup has more than one group. Choose the one to import.
apps.addressHint: The address you open Mealie at, like http://192.168.1.20:9000.
apps.tokenHint: Make one in Mealie under your profile, in API Tokens. It's only kept while the import runs.
apps.fromMealie_one: {{count}} from Mealie is here already, so it's skipped.
apps.fromMealie_other: {{count}} from Mealie are here already, so they're skipped.

plan.title: Plan
plan.poolHint: Meals for the week without a day yet. Put one on a day, or make it tonight.
plan.repeatedNone: Nothing to repeat: last week was empty, or its days are planned already.
plan.clear: Clear the rest of the week
plan.servingsHint: Leave it empty for the recipe's {{count}}.

fill.title: Fill the week
fill.description: Ideas from your recipes for the empty meals, from today on. Swap any you don't fancy.
fill.over: This week is over. Go to a later week to fill it.
fill.allPlanned: Those meals are all planned for the rest of the week.
fill.failed: Couldn't get ideas. Try again in a moment.
fill.nothing: Nothing new to suggest. Ideas come from your recipes, leaving out anything planned or made in the last two weeks and anything your tastes rule out, so add a few more. Tag breakfast and lunch recipes to have them suggested.
fill.unfilled_one: No idea for {{count}} meal: nothing new in your recipes fits.
fill.unfilled_other: No idea for {{count}} meals: nothing new in your recipes fits.

plan.noOther: No other ideas for this meal.

recipes.noneHint: Type in a family favorite to start your library.
recipes.noMatchesHint: Try other words, or fewer tags.

editor.yieldHint: When it isn't servings: “2 loaves”, “24 cookies”.
editor.totalHint: Leave it empty to add up prep and cook.
editor.ingredientsHint: One per line. Start a line with # for a section, like “# For the sauce”.
editor.ingredientsPlaceholder:
2 cups flour
1 tsp salt
# For the glaze
1 cup powdered sugar
editor.stepsHint: One step per line. # starts a section here too.
editor.stepsPlaceholder:
Heat the oven to 400°F.
Toss the vegetables with the oil and salt.
editor.tagsHint: Press Enter, or type a comma, after each one.
editor.notesHint: Tips, swaps, what to serve it with.

recipes.tagsHint: Rename a tag to another tag's name to merge the two.
recipes.deleteTagDescription: It comes off every recipe that has it. The recipes stay.
recipes.noTagsHint: Add tags to recipes in the editor.

versions.title: Versions
versions.description: How the recipe was before each change. Going back keeps how it is now as a version too.
versions.none: No earlier versions yet. Each change keeps one.

source.restore: Before going back to an earlier version

deleted.title: Recently deleted
deleted.description: Deleted recipes wait here for 30 days, then go for good.
deleted.keptFor: Put one back, or delete it for good now.
deleted.noneHint: Recipes you delete wait here for 30 days.
deleted.deleteForGoodDescription: It can't be put back after this.
deleted.emptyDescription_one: {{count}} recipe will be deleted for good. This can't be undone.
deleted.emptyDescription_other: {{count}} recipes will be deleted for good. This can't be undone.

import.description: Paste a link to a recipe, and Merran reads it off the page, photo and all.
import.linkNeeded: Paste a link to a recipe.
import.alreadyDescription: {{name}} came from this link. Open it, or add it again as a separate recipe.

links.title: Add several recipes
links.description: Links from a note, a message or anywhere else, one per line or mixed into text. They're added in the background, so you can carry on.
links.label: Links
links.placeholder: One per line, or mixed into any text
links.hint: Paste a list from a note, a message or anywhere else.
links.videos_one: {{count}} video can't be imported yet, so it's left out.
links.videos_other: {{count}} videos can't be imported yet, so they're left out.
links.more: Only the first 100 links: add the rest after.
links.progress: {{done}} of {{total}} done. It carries on if you leave this page.
links.gone: That import isn't here any more.

cookNotes.title: Cooking notes
cookNotes.none: How it went each time it was made. Finish cooking in the cook view to be asked.
cookNotes.askDescription: Rate {{name}}, and note anything to change next time.
cookNotes.placeholder: Anything to change next time? Like “needed more salt” or “5 minutes less in the oven”.

diets.label: Diet labels
diets.description: Worked out from the ingredients. If something's wrong, change it here; it sticks when the recipe is edited.
diets.setDespite: Set by you, though the recipe has {{lines}}
diets.fits: Nothing in the ingredients says otherwise
diets.caution: Packaged ingredients can surprise (stock, soy sauce, oats, chocolate). Check labels when it matters.

pairing.add: Add what it goes with, like sauces or sides
pairing.name: {{base}} with {{paired}}
pairing.title: What goes with {{name}}?
pairing.description: Pick recipes, or a whole tag so new ones join by themselves.
pairing.tagHint: Every recipe with the tag goes with {{name}}, including ones added later.
pairing.noTags: No tags yet. Tag your sauces “Sauce” to pair them all at once.

bulk.tagsDescription: Several at once, separated by commas.
bulk.deleteDescription_one: It goes to Recently deleted for 30 days, then it's gone for good.
bulk.deleteDescription_other: They go to Recently deleted for 30 days, then they're gone for good.
bulk.purgeDescription: There's no way back, and their photos go too.

cook.gatherHint: Get it all out and measured, ticking things off as you go.
cook.noStepsYet: This recipe has no steps yet. Add some from Edit.
cook.resumed: Picked up where you left off.
cook.made: Nice work. Marked as made today.

timers.label: {{label}} timer
timers.addMinuteTo: Add a minute to the {{label}} timer

handsFree.label: Hands-free
handsFree.title: Hands-free: steps read aloud, and commands by voice
handsFree.hint: Say next, back, read it, ingredients, timer for 10 minutes, or how much garlic.
handsFree.denied: Hands-free needs the microphone. Allow it in the browser's settings for this site.

voice.getReady_one: Get ready. Gather {{count}} ingredient. Say “ingredients” to hear it, or “next” to start.
voice.getReady_other: Get ready. Gather {{count}} ingredients. Say “ingredients” to hear them, or “next” to start.
voice.noSteps: This recipe has no steps yet.
voice.lastStep: That was the last step. Say “done” when you've finished.
voice.noneInStep: This step doesn't call for any of the ingredients.
voice.noTimeInStep: There's no time in this step. Say “timer for 10 minutes”.
voice.cantFind: I can't find {{food}} in this recipe.
voice.label: Voice
voice.none: This device has no voices for reading aloud.
voice.sample: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees, and season the chicken while it heats.
